title: bug(lsp): MCP workspace-discovery config starts a second, unused LSP server set per ACP process (inherits --experimental-lsp)
before: The ACP agent constructed a secondary Config for the workspace MCP discovery session by spreading the parent ACP argv into a second loadCliConfig call without overriding experimentalLsp. When the parent ACP process had experimentalLsp set to true, the discovery Config could also resolve LSP as enabled. loadCliConfig then constructed, prepared, and started a NativeLspService for that secondary Config even though the Config was initialized for MCP discovery and did not serve LSP requests, creating an unnecessary second LSP runtime.
after: The workspace MCP discovery Config still inherits the parent argv for relevant settings, but its local argv object explicitly sets experimentalLsp to false before calling loadCliConfig. Consequently, the discovery-only Config remains dedicated to MCP discovery and cannot start a NativeLspService from an inherited ACP LSP opt-in, while the parent ACP argv is not globally mutated. The committed test checks that the loadCliConfig invocation for the workspace-mcp-discovery session receives experimentalLsp: false.
diff: The pinned commit adds one production line in createWorkspaceMcpDiscoveryConfig: experimentalLsp: false immediately after ...this.argv and the discovery session id. It also updates acpAgent.test.ts to reset the shared mock flag between tests, adds an experimentalLsp=true fixture assignment in a workspace MCP initialization test, and asserts that the loadCliConfig call selected by sessionId workspace-mcp-discovery contains experimentalLsp: false.

evidence_units.claim: The issue bundle identifies issue 12216 as the workspace MCP-discovery/LSP inheritance bug and records d439660e32adc2a160db7e88ca6147698320db6f as its resolved commit with parent c767078ff7231c324ed703903a13749f2d7dac47.

The pinned commit is implementation-bearing: its subject is fix(acp): disable LSP for MCP discovery config (#12256), its body says the discovery-only Config starts MCP tools and never serves LSP requests, and it includes Fixes #12216; the commit changes acpAgent.ts and its test.

Relative to parent c767078ff7231c324ed703903a13749f2d7dac47, the production diff adds experimentalLsp: false to the argv object passed to the workspace-mcp-discovery loadCliConfig call after spreading the parent argv.

The post-change secondary configuration helper runs under the workspace-mcp-discovery session context, calls loadCliConfig, initializes the resulting Config with LLM, checkpointing, hooks, skills, and automatic MCP discovery skipped, then explicitly invokes discoverAllMcpToolsIncremental and stores the Config as the workspace discovery Config.

The workspaceMcpInitialize control path enqueues createWorkspaceMcpDiscoveryConfig, and the reload path invokes the same helper when the discovery Config does not yet exist, making the helper the shared construction boundary for the secondary workspace MCP runtime.
loadCliConfig derives lspEnabled from the resolved environment and argv: after excluding SSH, provisional-workspace, and bare modes, argv.experimentalLsp must be exactly true for LSP to be enabled.

When lspEnabled is true, loadCliConfig constructs a NativeLspService, calls discoverAndPrepare and start, and attaches a NativeLspClient; setting experimentalLsp to false therefore bypasses this LSP startup branch while leaving the separate MCP discovery calls available.

The test diff resets mockArgv.experimentalLsp to undefined in beforeEach and adds an experimentalLsp=true assignment in the safe-mode workspace MCP initialization fixture, ensuring the shared test argv does not leak between cases.

The workspace MCP discovery status test invokes workspaceMcpInitialize, waits for discoverAllMcpToolsIncremental, selects the loadCliConfig call whose sessionId is workspace-mcp-discovery, and asserts that its argv contains experimentalLsp: false.

The committed test oracle proves that the discovery call receives an explicit false override, but its experimentalLsp=true assignment is in a different test case from the later status assertion and beforeEach resets the flag for each test.

candidate_atomics.description: Apply a local capability override when building the secondary MCP discovery configuration so an LSP opt-in inherited from the parent ACP runtime cannot start an unused LSP stack.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent an MCP-discovery-only configuration from spawning an unused LSP runtime when the parent ACP process has opted into LSP.
semantic_action.pre_state: The secondary configuration derives its argv by spreading the parent ACP argument set, so the LSP feature flag may be true even though this runtime only performs MCP discovery.
semantic_action.post_state: The argv passed to the secondary configuration resolver has experimentalLsp set to false, so the resolved discovery Config cannot enter the LSP startup branch while its MCP discovery lifecycle remains enabled.
semantic_action.validation: The committed ACP unit test finds the loadCliConfig call for the workspace-mcp-discovery session and expects experimentalLsp to be false; the configuration resolver independently shows that false prevents NativeLspService construction and startup.
